content: A-ibagine, Rey-Asuero, Judío-dulemar-e-isdarad-Amán-e-neg e-ome-Esterʼga uksad. Geb Mardoqueo, Rey-Asuero-asabin gwisgunonikid, ar ade, Ester, Reyga sogsagusad Mardoqueoʼde, e-gwenadye.
Rey na e-olargan-Amán-annik-gannar-susadi unnusad, geb Mardoqueoʼga uksad. Ester bela Amán-e-ibmarmarga-gusad-dakega Mardoqueo-onugsasad.
Geb Ester, Rey-asabin ise-boar, sindigar-sii, wilesagwadgi gannar ese egisdebalid. Adi, Agag-dule-Amán, Judío-dulemar-oburgwega igar-isgana-uksagusad-osuloye, reyga sognai gusad.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero e-olo-gaapoled Esterʼsik oyosad. Agine, Ester gwisgusad. Geb Rey-asabin-gwichi,

Reyga sogded: —Rey, be yeer-an-dakele, be binsadibe napiragwadba an ibmar-egisnaiye, be nabir itogele, gardagi-narmakar be igar uksundo. Adi, Agag-dule Hamedata-machi-Amán Judío-dulemar bela rey-yarmargi-bukmalad-oburgwega garda-narmaksa-gusadi, be obelodo.
Ar an-dulemar-ogilolealile, ¿igi baisur-an-dakosunna? An-dulemar-oburgwilealile, ¿igi boo-an-dakosunna? An deyob geg gued.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero, e-ome-Esterʼga, degi, Judío-dule-Mardoqueoʼga sogded: —An Esterʼga, Amán-neg uksad. Ar Amán Judío-dulemar-oburgwebigusad-ulale, dukargi-atinnar bannu-bannu-nai burgwisad.

Emigindi, igi Judío-dulemar-bendaklebi be abemala, deyobi an-nuggi bemar garda narmakmala. Geb we-gardagi an-olargan-e-wilub bemar nasikmaloed. Ar ade, garda-soggwen an-nuggi narmaklesale, degi, a-gardagi an-olargan-e-wilub nasiklesale, narmakar-igar-uklesadi gege bar elileged.

Geb degine, nii-warbaagi, Siván-nii-gwichidgi, e-iba-durgwen-gakapaagi reyga-garda-narmakmaladse yog-gollar imaksamalad. Dule-garda-narmakmalad bela Mardoqueo ega igar-uksadba narmaksamalad: Judío-dulemarga, dummagan-negdakmamaid-Sátrapaʼmarye-nugmaladga, sordamar-idudimaladga, degi, India-yala-akale, Etiopía-yalase yarmar dulanergwa-gakagugle-naid (127), e-dummagan-negdakmamaidga garda narmaklesad. A-gardamar na gwabin-akar-akar-sunmakmaladba narmaklesad. Deginbali, Judío-dulemarga na e-gwabin-sunmakedba narmaklesmogad.

Mardoqueo, Rey-Asuero-nuggi garda narmaksagusad. Geb rey-e-olargan-e-wilub we-gardamargi nasiksad. Degine, reyga-gardamar-berbemaladba barmisad. We-dulemar rey-molimar-bela-belad-abarmakmalad-birgi-sii abarmakmaladid.

Rey garda-narmaksadgine bela neggwebur-iliba Judío-dulemar-na-san-bendakega sunna danar-ambikuye igar uksad. Deginbali, rey igar-uksabalid, doa-dulemar Judío-dulemar-oburgwebi-gudanimalale, Judío-dulemar sunna a-dulemar, e-omegan, degi, e-mimmigan oburgweye. Deginbali, Judío-dulemar sunna e-isdarmalad-ibe ibmar subarye.
Judío-dulemar, bela-Rey-Asuero-yargi nii-warambe gakabogi, e-iba ibambe-gakapaagi, weyob-ibmar-imakega, iba mesismalad. We-nii-warambe-gakabogwadde Adar-niiye-nugad.
Bela dulemar wisgumalaga, bela neggweburmar-iliba matagwen-matagwen igar-narmakar-megisad mimilegoed. Adi, a-ibagi, Judío-dulemar na e-isdarmalad-idu guagwar-bukumalaga, e-isdarmalad-abin gwisguegar.
Dule-garda-berbemaladi Rey-sogedba molimar-bela-belad-abarmakmalad-birgi-sii gwae-gwae nadmalad. Deginbali, we-igar-narmakar-megisadi, Susa-neggweburgi mimilesmogad.
Mardoqueo rey-asabin-gwichi, reymor-arad-yoi, reymor-sipugwad-yoi, ologurgin-dummad-sii, degi, suba-lino-nued-suir-akwagiid-yoi noded. Bela Susa-neggweburginmaladi weligwar-itogedba oimakdemalad.
Judío-dulemargardi bela yeer-neg-itogedbi nagusad, weligwar itodmalad, nug-dungudmalad.

Bela yarmar-iliba, neggweburmar-iliba rey-igar-mesisad-modapile, Judío-dulemar na weligwar-itoddamalad, yeer-itoddamalad, na iba-dummad onoddamalad. Bukidar dulemar-yar-baidsikmalad Judío-dulemar-dobedba na emarde Judío-duleye sogdemalad.
